_comment: Line-drawn trees and shrubs (MCEntourage). generator 'tree': style bare (winter branching) | canopy (scalloped crown + foliage strokes) | conifer; height, spread (crown width / height), depth (branching levels, bare), trunk (diameter), strokes (canopy). generator 'shrub': height, width, bumps, strokes. 'seed' picks the random variation; MCEntourage Random=Yes gives every placement its own.
